name: 911 Setup
description: Automates the full 911 QTDR batch setup behind a checklist of actions to run - which it remembers between sessions: creates nest folders, copies and fills 911 Batch templates with forecast, PDF, and quote data, generates inspection sheets, and stamps the Move Ticket Omit PDFs (with a toggleable difficulty label). Handles SHAPE and PLATE batches - tick 'PLATE batch' in the checklist for plate work (plate template and scribe doc, MIL SPEC N/A on carbon, trace pulled from the forecast); it resets to SHAPE every run on purpose. Teams cards are their own app now (911 Teams Cards) and are OFF here by default - tick them if you want cards and setup in one pass. Nest numbers are sourced from the Quote File NEST column.
author: Anthony Sieben

setup: Sync the '911 QTDR' folder in OneDrive and make sure the batch's folder (e.g. S035) is there with its BATCH LIST and NEST PACKAGES.
Keep the Working Forecast List up to date and synced - the app pulls each nest's forecast data from it.
Close any nest workbooks or PDFs from an earlier run that are open in Excel or Acrobat, so the app can overwrite them.
how_it_works: Tick the actions to run - your selection is remembered, so a step you always skip stays unticked next time. Generate Teams Cards is off by default and needs no batch number.

Setting up plate work? Tick 'PLATE batch' - the run then uses the plate workbook template and plate scribe form, writes MIL SPEC as N/A for carbon (ferrous) stock, and fills the scribe sheet's UNIQUE - TRACE column from the forecast's TRACE/MIC column. This one toggle is never remembered: every run starts back at SHAPE so a plate run can't silently bleed into the next shape batch.
Enter the batch number, then check which nests to set up (nests already built are flagged).
For each nest it creates the nest folder, copies and fills the 911 Batch template with forecast, material, and quote data, and builds the per-piece inspection sheets.
It also pulls the nest's drawings PDF, removing the MOVE TICKET pages and stamping the cover with the batch and nest.
output: One folder per nest, each with a filled '911 BATCH {batch} {nest}.xlsx' and its inspection sheets.
A '{nest} MOVE TICKET OMIT.pdf' drawings file in each nest folder.
A scribe-verification doc dropped into each nest's PRODUCTION PAPERWORK folder.

fields.label: 911 QTDR Base Directory
fields.description: Path to the '911 QTDR' folder. Leave blank to use the default OneDrive path under your home directory.
fields.placeholder: C:\Users\YourName\American Steel & Alum\Communication site - Electric Boat ASA Docs\Pilot Program\911 QTDR

fields.label: Forecast and Inventory Reports Directory
fields.description: Path to the 'Forecast and Inventory Reports' folder containing 'Working Forecast List.xlsx'. Leave blank to use the default OneDrive path.
fields.placeholder: C:\Users\YourName\American Steel & Alum\Communication site - Electric Boat ASA Docs\Pilot Program\Forecast and Inventory Reports

fields.label: Template Subfolder
fields.description: Subfolder under 911 QTDR where the '911 BATCH _.xlsx' template lives. Change only if the template was relocated.

fields.label: Working Forecast Filename
fields.description: Name of the forecast workbook inside the Forecast and Inventory Reports folder.

fields.label: EB 922 Schedule Path
fields.description: Full path to 'EB 922 Schedule.xlsx' - the source of the Teams-card work list and the difficulty ratings. Leave blank to auto-detect it under your OneDrive Pilot Program folder.
fields.placeholder: Auto-detect: ... \ 922 QTDR Production Packages \ 2 - Planning \ EB 922 Schedule.xlsx

fields.label: Teams Webhook URL (override)
fields.description: Leave blank to use TechDeck's built-in card-creation flow. Only set this to point at a different Power Automate flow (get the URL from that flow's trigger). Use the dry run toggle below to preview without posting.

fields.label: Teams cards: dry run (preview only)
fields.description: When on, build and log the cards and save a preview JSON, but do not post them. Forced on automatically when no webhook URL is set.
